issue.title: task loop: allowlist too wide, old git accepted
issue.body:
Two problems in `scripts/task_loop.py`. The unattended-merge allowlist accepts any path under `docs/`, not only Markdown files there. And the loop starts on a git older than 2.41, which ignores `GIT_ATTR_SOURCE`, so a worktree `.gitattributes` filter could run on the host.

## Done when

- Only `docs/**/*.md` and the root `README.md` are allowlisted.
- `run` and `run-one` refuse git older than 2.41 with a message naming 2.41.
- `uv run --no-sync python3 tests/test_task_loop.py` passes.
